constraints.name: BOARD_RANGE
constraints.derivation: manufacturing caliper range (compensated mode; the t = 0 legacy layout is covered by the byte-stability snapshot, not this domain)

constraints.name: DEPTH_VS_WIDTH_RATIO
constraints.derivation: schema Milestone 9.1 rule (dust flap collapse beyond)

constraints.name: GLUE_VS_SIDE
constraints.derivation: the glue flap laps inside the side span

constraints.name: DUST_PAIR_CLEARANCE
constraints.derivation: FOLDED (engine's own reconciliation rule): D-derived dust flaps fold across the W opening; W < 1.262 D collides — the measured 28x28x120 reference itself violates this (overlap 7.3 mm)

constraints.name: TUCK_LIP_VS_HEIGHT
constraints.derivation: FOLDED (engine's own reconciliation rule): the W-derived tuck lip must stay far shorter than the body — wide-short cartons (incl. the historical 90x25x92 STE die) violate this

constraints.name: DUST_CLAMP_BOUNDARY
constraints.derivation: EXPLICIT clamp edge (mandated): beyond it the engine clamps the dust height — a clamped flap is an altered formula, outside the qualified domain

constraints.name: SLIT_WEB_UNREDUCED
constraints.formula: web >= 2 mm at the nominal slit width (numeric, DECISION-017)
constraints.derivation: the friction slit must fit without the web-guard reduction
